query:
SELECT 
  m.attendeeId,
  m.timeSlot,
  CASE m.timeSlot
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Wed 10:15'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Wed 10:45'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Wed 13:30'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Wed 14:00'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Wed 14:45'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Wed 15:15'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Thu 10:30'
    WHEN 8 THEN 'Thu 11:00'
    WHEN 9 THEN 'Thu 13:15'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'Thu 13:45'
    WHEN 11 THEN 'Thu 14:30'
    WHEN 12 THEN 'Thu 15:00'
  END as slotTime,
  s.companyName as sponsor,
  m.id as meetingId
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE 
  (m.attendeeId = '76678269091' AND m.timeSlot IN (1,2))   -- Adam Binks
  OR (m.attendeeId = '9322701'   AND m.timeSlot IN (1))     -- Tush Wijeratne
  OR (m.attendeeId = '174442448959' AND m.timeSlot IN (3,4)) -- Joanna Hackett
  OR (m.attendeeId = '93176107633' AND m.timeSlot IN (7))   -- Mark Kunaseelan
  OR (m.attendeeId = '8196151'   AND m.timeSlot IN (8))     -- Michelle Monahan
  OR (m.attendeeId = '91889321035' AND m.timeSlot IN (10))  -- Lucy Bousfield
  OR (m.attendeeId = '4956154'   AND m.timeSlot IN (11))    -- Jules Anderson
ORDER BY m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot;
